briefdescription.para: Check if subsystem has permission to access a node.

parameterdescription.para: Node ID to check access for

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if allowed, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem is NULL, error code if denied
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate IsAccessAllowed implementation via the SubsystemOps table. Checks permissions based on node class (device, clock, reset, pin, etc.).

briefdescription.para: Subsystem Manager - Single unified object Always defined here, regardless of build configuration.
Get subsystem by ID.

simplesect.para: Pointer to XPm_Subsystem if successful else NULL
This function serves as the abstraction layer between runtime core and subsystem implementation. It always uses the unified SubsysMgr regardless of build configuration.

briefdescription.para: Get the maximum subsystem index currently present in the system.

simplesect.para: Maximum subsystem index (0-based), or 0 if no subsystems exist
This value is updated when subsystems are added and is used for efficient iteration over subsystem indices.

briefdescription.para: Check if subsystem has permission to access a node (public API wrapper)

parameterdescription.para: Node ID to check access for

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if allowed, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem not found, error code if denied
Public API wrapper that retrieves the subsystem by ID and calls XPmSubsystem_IsAccessAllowed. This function provides a convenient interface when only the subsystem ID is available.

briefdescription.para: This function gives Subsystem from Subsystem "INDEX".

simplesect.para: Pointer to XPm_Subsystem if successful else NULL

This is a less strict version of XPmSubsystem_GetByIndex(), and mainly is implemented due to other modules such as xpm_device needs to access the subsystem database and iterate over it using indexes only, without the need to use the complete subsystem ID. Use this function where it is absolutely necessary.

briefdescription.para: Get subsystem ID by matching IPI mask.

parameterdescription.para: IPI mask to match against subsystem's IPI mask

simplesect.para: Subsystem ID if found and subsystem is not offline, INVALID_SUBSYSID otherwise
Searches through all subsystems to find one where the provided IPI mask matches the subsystem's IPI mask. Only returns subsystems that are not in OFFLINE state.

briefdescription.para: Add a new subsystem to the power management framework.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_DEVICE_BUSY if subsystem already exists, XST_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL on allocation failure
Creates and initializes a new subsystem object with default state (ONLINE), adds it to the subsystem list, and updates the maximum subsystem index tracker.

briefdescription.para: Release all devices of a subsystem that is being restarted, forced down or shut down.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code or a reason code
FPD is held on across the release, see XPmPower_HoldFpd()

briefdescription.para: Activate a subsystem by requesting all pre-allocated devices.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem is NULL, error code on failure
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate Activate implementation via the SubsystemOps table. The actual implementation may be a common function or a build-specific override.

briefdescription.para: Set the state of a subsystem.

parameterdescription.para: New state value (must be less than MAX_STATE)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem is NULL, error code on failure
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate SetState implementation via the SubsystemOps table.

briefdescription.para: Get the current status/state of a subsystem.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to device status structure to populate

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem or DeviceStatus is NULL, error code on failure
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate GetStatus implementation via the SubsystemOps table.

briefdescription.para: Add a requirement (device/reset/subsystem) to a subsystem.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem, Payload is NULL or PayloadLen is 0, error code on failure
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate AddRequirement implementation via the SubsystemOps table. The payload format depends on the node type being added as a requirement.

briefdescription.para: Wake up a subsystem from suspended state.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem is NULL, error code on failure
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate WakeUp implementation via the SubsystemOps table.

briefdescription.para: Suspend a subsystem (enter low-power state)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem is NULL, error code on failure
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate Suspend implementation via the SubsystemOps table.

briefdescription.para: Idle a subsystem (prepare for low-power state)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem is NULL, error code on failure
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate Idle implementation via the SubsystemOps table.

briefdescription.para: Finalize subsystem initialization after successful boot.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem is NULL, error code on failure
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate InitFinalize implementation via the SubsystemOps table. Typically notifies healthy boot to stop healthy boot monitors.

briefdescription.para: Notify that subsystem has booted successfully (releases healthy boot monitors)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem is NULL, error code on failure
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate NotifyHealthyBoot implementation via the SubsystemOps table. Releases healthy boot monitor devices allocated to the subsystem.

briefdescription.para: Start recovery timer for subsystem (healthy boot monitor)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID if subsystem is NULL, error code on failure
Wrapper function that dispatches to the appropriate StartRecoveryTimer implementation via the SubsystemOps table. Requests runtime healthy boot monitor device to start recovery timer.

briefdescription.para: Initialize the subsystem module.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS
This function is reserved for future module initialization needs. Currently returns success as a placeholder.
